name: Tanaka Ryuu
source: Tanaka Ryuu is your typical salaryman who worked as an accountant in a company. He lives a boring life full of work every day until one day he went drinking with his colleagues at Shinjuku after work. As he heads home, a nice girl in a bunny outfit introduced to him “Usagi Health Club” a health club for people like him. Reluctantly, he decided to give it a try.
